messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- On 2026-05-18, the Ember team noticed that the auth gateway's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-05-18 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-18-2]
- The security audit flagged the auth gateway's long-lived tokens. [valid 2026-01-22 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-01-22]
- As of 2025-12-23, the auth gateway is owned by Team Atlas, which took it over from Team Boreal. [valid 2025-12-23 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-23-auth-gateway]
    earlier: As of 2025-03-31, the auth gateway is a Team Boreal service. [valid 2025-03-31 to 2025-12-23; recorded by handover/2025-03-31-auth-gateway]
    earlier: The auth gateway is an Ember team service. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-03-31; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-20-2]
- On 2026-01-22, Team Atlas decided that auth gateway tokens will expire after 15 minutes instead of an hour. [decision; valid 2026-01-22 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-01-22]
- On 2025-12-29, the Ember team observed that the auth gateway's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift. [valid 2025-12-29 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-12-29-2]
- As of 2026-05-25, Team Atlas has switched to a no-deploy Friday. [decision; valid 2026-05-25 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-05-25-2]
- As of 2026-04-16, the ledger deploys on Mondays and Wednesdays between 14:00 and 16:00 UTC; the old Wednesday 09:00-11:00 UTC slot is retired. [constraint; valid 2026-04-16 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-04-16]
    earlier: Per the change policy, the ledger deploys on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-04-18 to 2026-04-16; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-04-18]
- Changes to the auth gateway require two reviewer approvals and a security sign-off. [constraint; valid 2025-08-14 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-08-14]
- There is a deploy freeze on the ledger from 2026-03-30 to 2026-04-03 because of the fiscal year close. [constraint; valid 2026-03-19 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-03-19]
- As of 2025-12-23, the pager for the auth gateway rings Team Atlas instead of Team Boreal. [valid 2025-12-23 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-23-auth-gateway]
- INC-2025-017 was an incident affecting the auth gateway on 2025-07-27. [valid 2025-08-01 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-017]
- On 2026-03-31, the Ember team observed that the feature-flags service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and flagged it because the service is not theirs. [valid 2026-03-31 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-03-31]
- Per the change policy, the auth gateway deploys on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays. [constraint; valid 2025-01-29 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-29]
- The ledger relies on the auth gateway for service tokens, so if the auth gateway is down, the ledger service is down. [valid 2025-03-17 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-03-17]
- There is a deploy freeze on the billing service from 2025-11-24 to 2025-12-02 because of peak season. [constraint; valid 2025-11-04 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-11-04]
- On 2026-01-13, Team Atlas noticed that the ledger's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-01-13 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-01-13]
- Team Cinder flagged that the auth gateway's cold start time tripled following the runtime upgrade. [valid 2025-02-21 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-02-21]
- On 2026-02-12, the Ember team reported that the indexer's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy. [valid 2026-02-12 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-02-12]
- On 2025-07-28, Team Cinder reported that the ledger's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy. [valid 2025-07-28 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-07-28-2]
- On 2026-05-25, Team Atlas reported that the webhooks service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change. [valid 2026-05-25 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-05-25-2]
